primaryObjective: Make coordinate evidence a defensible, provenance-preserving Analysis assessment that separates source-provided coordinates, generalized public markers, and unresolved conflicts without upgrading precision by inference.
hypothesis: The 110,352 rows with source-coordinate evidence across Majestic and UFOCAT can support an immutable coordinate audit lane with explicit origin, precision, country-consistency, and failure status while retaining generalized and unresolved markers as separate non-inferential states.

inScope: immutable event-aligned coordinate evidence sidecar with original latitude, longitude, source role, and precision class
typed coordinate validity, country-consistency, dateline, high-latitude, duplicate-lineage, and unresolved-conflict statuses
descriptive source-era-region coverage and conservative quality comparison
compact Sources and Spatial evidence disclosure plus JSON and CSV evidence export
deterministic provenance, release, preview, production, and rollback receipts
outOfScope: promoting country, state, city, centroid, or generalized public markers to source-coordinate precision
silently repairing swapped, zero, out-of-range, or country-inconsistent coordinates
facility, crop, animal, incidence, risk, authenticity, travel, or causal claims
any assessment other than coordinate evidence

requiredFields: original latitude and longitude when present
estimators: source-era-region common-support standardized active/reference share difference
negativeControls: unresolved and invalid coordinates remain excluded
readinessContract.uncertaintyTreatment: Original coordinates, coordinate origin, precision, generalized public markers, and country-consistency conflicts remain distinct. Invalid, ambiguous, missing, swapped, zero-sentinel, or unresolved values fail closed and are never upgraded by inference.
readinessContract.suppressionPolicy: Show readiness and descriptive failure counts instead of inferential comparisons whenever typed coverage, provenance integrity, common support, bin support, or stability gates fail. Never treat missing coordinates as zero or generalized markers as exact sites.

releaseGates: coordinate-origin separation, original-value preservation, and idempotence
country-consistency, dateline, high-latitude, zero-sentinel, and duplicate-lineage tests
statistical determinism, common support, FDR isolation, and holdout stability
no geocoding, precision promotion, raw-count-driven inference, or Pattern Finder promotion in v1
Pages and R2 separation with immutable versioned R2 keys
desktop and mobile browser QA, keyboard, themes, reduced motion, exports, and zero console errors
identical frozen Pages package preview to production and tested rollback
stopConditions: fewer than 88281 rows retain typed source-coordinate evidence without geocoding or canonical repair
fewer than two sources retain at least 1000 typed rows
source coordinates and generalized public markers cannot remain distinct
the assessment requires a second browser event model
rights or provenance cannot be resolved
performance or existing Analysis behavior regresses beyond release gates
